thread:
Mei Lin: quick design review — onboarding checklist ordering feels off. Users expect 'Connect data' before 'Try sample projects'. Also banner copy maybe too action-y for first run. Thoughts?
Carlos Vega: agree on reorder. Most customers want to connect at least one data source first. Suggest reorder to: 1) Create API key, 2) Connect dataset, 3) Try sample project, 4) Review quota.
Priya Shah: UX research backs that. In first 20 sessions, 68% tried sample before connecting and got confused. If we gate sample import with a small note 'Tip: connect data to use samples with your own data' it might help.
Tom Rivers: implementation note: gating = show a disabled import button with tooltip linking to dataset page. But that adds complexity for mobile widths. Alternative: keep import enabled but surface an inline toast after import explaining where to connect real data.
Mei Lin: prefer inline guidance rather than blocking. Can we tweak banner copy to be less imperative? Current: 'Get started: Import a sample project' -> proposed: 'Try a sample project to explore Redwood — you can connect your data anytime.'
design-bot: updated Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/onboarding?node-id=12%3A345 — new banner variant 'gentle-cta' uses 16px body, 600 weight CTA and secondary link.
Carlos Vega: accessibility nit: the banner close button lacks accessible label in the mobile collapsed view. It reads just 'button' in VoiceOver iOS. Need aria-label="Dismiss onboarding banner".
Priya Shah: also keyboard order in the checklist card list: screen readers jump to the last item first because of absolute-positioned status icons. Fix by moving icons after text in DOM or marking them `aria-hidden=true`.
Tom Rivers: CSS approach: keep visual order with flexbox but put icons after content in DOM. That means small layout tweak but keeps AT happy.
Mei Lin: analytics ask: can we add event 'onboarding.checklist.step_clicked' with properties step_name and step_position so we can A/B test reorder impact?
Carlos Vega: yep, will add event and a simple experiment flag `onboarding_v2_order`. We should instrument impression and completion events too.
Priya Shah: copy micro tweak for checklist items: items should be verbs first: 'Create API key', 'Connect a dataset', 'Import sample project', 'Review usage limits'. That helps scannability.
Mei Lin: sample cards: reduce visual noise. Remove the tiny gray 'beta' pill — it's not needed for samples and is low contrast. If we must keep it, change contrast to meet AA.
design-bot: changed token `--pill-muted` to #576772 which meets 4.6:1 on #f3f5f7. Frame 'Checklist / v2' updated.
Tom Rivers: dev tasks — 1) reorder checklist DOM + ARIA improvements, 2) banner copy + aria-label on close, 3) sample card DOM reorder and tooltip copy. I'll split into PRs.
Mei Lin: can we get a quick accessibility smoke test after PR? @ux-research-bot can run the lightweight script across NVDA/VO?
ux-research-bot: scheduled quick smoke: NVDA+Firefox and VoiceOver+Safari. Tests: banner label, checklist reading order, sample card announcements, CTA focus order. ETA: 48 hours.
Carlos Vega: leaving a small note — update onboarding docs ('onboarding.md') with the new step order and copy. Also add a short paragraph about why samples are suggested after connecting data.
Priya Shah: final tiny copy change for empty state: 'No projects yet' -> 'No projects yet — try a sample or connect your data to create one.' Better signals two options.
Mei Lin: thanks everyone. Let's review the first PR tomorrow standup. If PRs are small we can ship in patch release. :rocket:
